name: band-coach-store-shell
description: One coach, many instruments, drum kit included. Band Coach listens through your microphone, a MIDI keyboard or a drum kit that sends MIDI, picks every next exercise from your own results, and watches your energy so practice stays fresh. It includes a tuner, and it hears pitch and timing — it cannot see posture, breath, bowing or hand position, so keep a teacher for those. Free, no account, and your sound never leaves your computer.

scripts.dist:appx: npm run prepare-app && node scripts/apply-identity.mjs && electron-builder --win appx --config electron-builder.generated.json
scripts.dist:appx:submission: npm run prepare-app -- --require-release && node scripts/apply-identity.mjs --require-identity && electron-builder --win appx --config electron-builder.generated.json
